solutions.title: BFS with alternating inserts
solutions.strategy: Process one queue level at a time and append values to the front on right-to-left levels.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is dequeued once and each value is inserted into exactly one level list.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The returned levels store n values; auxiliary queue space is O(w) for the maximum tree width.

solutions.title: DFS depth buckets
solutions.strategy: Create one bucket per depth and place values at the front for odd depths.

timeComplexity.explanation: DFS visits each node once and performs O(1) bucket insertion with linked/deque buckets.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The returned levels store n values; auxiliary recursion stack space is O(h).
